description: Create or recover a public live preview link to a site page without publishing. Anyone with the URL can view the draft from your account's existing preview workspace. Use projectId from list_projects and siteId from list_sites; supply the page route and omit locale for the default. Page availability is checked when the link opens. Share only when requested; if the preview workspace is missing, report that state without editing or publishing the site.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag to render the page in, e.g. "en-US". Omit to use the site's default locale.

route.description: The site route to preview, e.g. "/" or "/about". Must be an absolute path without a query string or fragment.

name: create_shared_preview
title: Create shared preview
